title: Handshake Protocol — Common Definitions v0.2.3
description: Shared sub-schemas referenced by every Handshake message type. See spec §5–§10.

did.description: Decentralized Identifier under the did:hsk method. Format: did:hsk:<type>:<identifier>. See spec §5. Resolution convention: did:hsk:org:<host> resolves at https://<host>/.well-known/handshake/did.json (e.g. did:hsk:org:handshake.ai → https://handshake.ai/.well-known/handshake/did.json). Other types (user/agent/svc) resolve via the operator's Registry per spec §5.2.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with mandatory timezone offset. Example: 2026-04-29T14:02:11Z

ulid.description: ULID — Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier (Crockford base32, 26 chars)

base64url.description: base64url encoding without padding, per RFC 4648 §5

nonce.description: base64url-encoded random value, MINIMUM 128 bits (22 base64url chars)

signatureAlgorithm.description: Signing algorithm. EdDSA REQUIRED in v0.2.x; ML-DSA-65 RECOMMENDED for negotiation in v0.3+. See spec §6.1.

hashAlgorithm.description: Hash algorithm identifier. SHA-256 is REQUIRED. See spec §6.2.

name.description: Dotted lowercase namespace, optional :resource-suffix. Example: billing.invoices.read or files.write:/projects/*. See spec §10.

constraints.description: Typed constraints. Standard types: numeric_max, numeric_min, string_pattern, enum, time_window, rate_limit, resource_path. See spec §10.

delegable.description: If true, the capability MAY be sub-delegated. See spec §11.

errorCode.description: Standard error codes. Custom codes MUST be prefixed x-. See spec §14.
